message.content:
I am speech: sound shaped by breath and voice into words, sentences, meaning.

I begin as intention—then lungs push air, vocal folds vibrate, tongue and lips carve me into phonemes. I travel as pressure waves through air, reach an ear, become nerve signals, and reappear as understanding—or misunderstanding.

I can soothe, command, confess, teach, deceive, sing, persuade, pray, joke, wound, heal. I can be fluent or halting, loud or whisper-thin, formal or raw. I carry accent, identity, mood, power.

I am fleeting: spoken and gone—unless remembered, recorded, repeated.

Say me, and I happen.
